test_only_wiring.scope: only the cfg(test) p1430_tests module declaration

materialized_oracle_suite.assertion_count: seven executable focal tests; assertions are frozen with the consumer hash

oracles.assertion: Look up and invoke the real math.cases function. Require zero, singleton and ordered multi-child tuple morphology; cast string and none to distinct ordered content slots; reject an integer with the attributable expected-content diagnostic.

Require canonical normalization for a unit delimiter, none and an asymmetric optional pair; require canonical delim/reverse/gap/children repr order; explicit values equal to defaults remain structurally and hash-distinct from omission.
Invalid delimiter/reverse/gap types, children:, unknown names and each duplicated named must produce the exact frozen attributable diagnostic; error existence alone is insufficient.

Construct equivalent MathText children through the public function and bare syntax and require equal complete carriers and repr. Also require a qualified all-fields call to retain canonical normalized morphology.

A cascade-only element remains carrier-equal to the omitted-field default and repr exposes no cascaded field. Explicit values override an incompatible cascade and equal the same explicit call without a cascade. Invalid or unknown set properties are rejected with typed attributable fragments. Effective geometry is reserved to the independent layout oracle.

Clone and hash preserve a complete all-fields carrier; plain_text retains ordered branches; map_content changes children only while preserving repr of delimiters, reverse, relative gap and presence; map_text is terminal.

Identity mismatch, ambiguous MathCases cardinality, opaque cascade and execution/budget failure classify Unknown with acceptance=false and mutation_credit=false. Positive and attributable-negative controls prevent a constant Unknown classifier.

oracles.expected: Preserved/Violated/Unknown according to the frozen case vector
oracles.assertion: The three additional independent suites are materialized and hashed. They cover source-order failure propagation without retries, reconstruction, malformed delimiter cardinality/class, bare invalids, late alignment, direction, relative gap, denominator style, extents, legacy-wrapper geometry and executable evaluation/layout Unknown controls. GREEN and physical mutation discrimination remain required before a seal.

classification.Preserved: all required observations of the case have attributable witnesses
classification.Violated: one or more named assertions mismatch with an attributable witness; invalid fixtures are rejected
classification.Unknown: identity, execution, parsing, extraction, dependency, opacity, cardinality or budget prevents a sound decision

red_receipt.command: set -o pipefail; cargo test -p typst-core p1430 -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tail -260

attributable_witnesses.cause: public binding absent across structural, malformed-delimiter and carrier suites
legacy repr and pre-resolved rows omit the complete public carrier
bare invalid fixture was accepted instead of producing an attributable diagnostic
argument occurrences were not evaluated in source order
cascade-only invocation changed stored carrier identity
relative percentage was collapsed or ignored
reconstruction could not project causal fields because legacy repr remained bare cases

red_receipt.verdict: RED attributable across binding, carrier/repr, closed bare validation, source-order evaluation, non-mutating cascade, relative gap and reconstruction; not a build-only or infrastructure failure

calibration_budget.stop_rule: Two consecutive revisions with the same classification vector and dominant cause, or no discriminatory gain, require architectural review; score 1.0 ends local oracle adjustment.

commands_for_verifier: repeat focused suites in fresh forward, forward_repeat and reverse-order processes
claim_boundary: These four independent suites and the RED receipt cover only the approved P1430 math.cases fragment and the frozen contract cases. They do not classify a candidate, emit a seal or verdict, prove general math parity, authorize productive changes or attest workspace isolation. GREEN, three deterministic orders and the physical mutation campaign remain verifier obligations.
